name: 一般现在时
structure: 主语 + do/does (第三人称单数加-s/es)
usage: 表示经常性或习惯性的动作
表示客观真理、事实
表示现在的状态

examples.en: He goes to school every day.
The earth moves around the sun.

name: 一般过去时
usage: 表示过去某个时间发生的动作或状态
常搭配：yesterday, last week, in 2020, ago

examples.en: I visited my grandparents last weekend.
examples.cn: 上周末我拜访了祖父母

name: 一般将来时
structure: will + do / am(is,are) going to + do
usage: 表示将来要发生的动作或状态
will表示临时决定或客观将来
be going to表示计划或根据迹象推测

examples.en: I will help you with your homework.
It is going to rain tomorrow.

name: 现在进行时
usage: 表示现在正在进行的动作
表示现阶段正在进行的事
常搭配：now, at the moment, look, listen

examples.en: They are having an English class now.
Look! The dog is running after the cat.

name: 过去进行时
usage: 表示过去某时刻正在进行的动作
常搭配：at 8:00 yesterday, when/while

examples.en: I was reading when he came in.
They were playing football at 4 pm yesterday.
examples.cn: 昨天下午4点他们在踢足球

name: 现在完成时
usage: 表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响
表示从过去持续到现在的动作或状态
常搭配：already, yet, ever, never, just, since, for

examples.en: I have finished my homework already.
She has lived here for ten years.

name: 过去完成时
usage: 表示在过去某个时间或动作之前已经发生的动作
即"过去的过去"

examples.en: When I arrived, the train had left.
examples.cn: 我到达时火车已经开了

examples.en: He said he had finished the work.
examples.cn: 他说他已经完成了工作

name: 被动语态
structure: am/is/are + done (现在) / was/were + done (过去) / will be + done (将来) / have/has been + done (完成)
usage: 不知道或不必说出动作的执行者
强调动作的承受者

examples.en: English is spoken all over the world.
The work will be finished tomorrow.
